## Mode
greenfield

## Problem Statement
Ship a socket-liveness watchdog for the jarvis Slack door. The real Slack ingress on-box is the `jarvis serve-nats` systemd user unit, but that unit is not versioned in the repo — only the wrong `jarvis-frontdoor.service` (langgraph dev) is — and nothing notices if its NATS subscription goes stale, an absent-operator failure with no self-recovery. (1) Version the real `jarvis-serve-nats.service` into `ops/systemd/` with a coordinator install step, matching the existing `jarvis-frontdoor` README pattern. (2) Add a watchdog that reads `journalctl --user -u jarvis-serve-nats` for socket/subscription staleness and posts an alert to Slack when the door goes quiet. (3) Correct the O-30 register row to name serve-nats — not langgraph dev — as the Slack door. Ops files + a watchdog script only: no app source, no compose deploy. jarvis is not a DCL venue.
